title: MiniMax H3 - Video Generation
description: Generic volume-based MiniMax H3 worker for 32-48GB GPUs. For fixed Ada/5090 images in Runpod's managed registry, import GitHub using the deploy/runpod Dockerfiles. Staged loading, quality/speed presets and optional TensorRT post-processing.

input.name: Auto-download models
input.description: Download only the models selected for the visible GPU. Attach a persistent network volume (160GB recommended).

input.name: Hugging Face token
input.description: Optional — only needed if you edit models-manifest.txt to pull from gated Hugging Face repos. All bundled models are public.

input.name: Job timeout (seconds)
input.description: Max seconds a single generation job may run before the worker aborts it.

input.name: ComfyUI extra args
input.description: Additional non-conflicting ComfyUI flags. Memory/cache/fast-attention overrides are rejected by the staged profiles.

input.name: MMH3_GPU_PROFILE
input.description: auto, rtx6000_ada_48, l40s_48, pro6000_mig_48 or rtx5090_32. Auto uses the visible GPU/MIG capacity.

input.name: MMH3_PRESET
input.description: Default preset: quality (20 native steps) or speed (8-step FL2VA / 4-step Ref2VA).

input.name: MMH3_ENCODER_FAMILY
input.description: official (default) or heretic. Precision is selected for the GPU architecture.

input.name: MMH3_DOWNLOAD_ENHANCER
input.description: Download optional Qwen3.5-9B prompt enhancement weights.

input.name: MMH3_DOWNLOAD_SINGULARITY
input.description: Download optional Singularity v1.3 Pruned INT8.

input.name: MMH3_DOWNLOAD_STYLE_LORAS
input.description: Download optional Realism and Character-Swap LoRAs (Singularity).
